reviews.author: YS Sanderson
reviews.text: Matt is fair. Period. Good work for my first experience. Diagnosed my trucks oil leak onto my alternator in 10 mins and had me quoted and scheduled in 15 mins. Started on my car first thing on the day and was in at 1030 and out by 1300. Definitely worth giving a second job to vs the BS and game of other local shops who see me coming. If I'm going to support local business I want fair and honest in return and that's what I got with City Point.

reviews.author: ZDude
reviews.text: Genuine uslessness all around here. Dropped off my car for a simple inspection, got told it'll be 45 minutes. 3 and a half hours later im late to work. No text, no call, and certainly no inspection. These guys will tell you a bold face lie while they completely disregard your time. Don't come here, these people have no idea how to run a business. Their lot is more of a junkyard than a shop anyways.

reviews.author: ИeKeshia B.
reviews.text: The worst experience EVER!!! I was told by someone that they had good prices, and I was on a budget! Didn't know who to trust..so I went with someone I knew who had taken their car. Their car still need work too..so I should have known better. I took my car there the first week of June for a diagnosis. Found out they don't have a working phone, so what they do is..take your number, and never call you! These ppl literally had my car from june till August and never called me. I had to come there serval time to ask them the progress to find out there wasn't any progress! Car sat in the same spot the tow left it the whole time! Yesterday I had enough of the games, and I went there with a tow, and took my car somewhere else. It took an ammaco one hour to tell me what was wrong with my car! I'm a woman, so they played in my face for damn near 2 months! I wouldn't recommend anyone to go to them, they are shady ! They also decided to keep my battery. I had to find this out after I left ! After all this time wasted, damn near, ready to lose my job....paying for lyfts... calling out from work and wasting my time with this shady shop. im finally done with this trash business. I guess they work on who they know or like car first..your car is just in a lottery, that they can care less about. I forgot how they would leave my car door unlocked..dont care if your belongings are stolen! I know this because I have gotten rides to my car, and all the doors were unlocked!!!! They need to be shut down ASAP!

reviews.author: Jacqueline Anderson
reviews.text: The owner/operator and his staff were very busy because he does good work, and his prices are affordable, so, many people frequent his shop. He took time out to squeeze me in when I just showed up, and he fixed my bumper, which I'd accidentally pulled loose, and he didn't even charge me anything! He didn't know me, he certainly didn't owe me anything, yet he was kind enough to do that for me. I told him my son had recommended him/his shop to me, and that was enough for him! I really appreciate him taking the time to do that for me!

reviews.author: Annette Ahrend
reviews.text: City point service station is located in Hopewell. They do all kind of auto repairs as well as inspections. Matt owns this service station as well as manages it really good. Me and my fiance come here every time we need an inspection on are vehicles. I recommend City point service station.

reviews.author: Ronald Lee
reviews.text: I don't normally leave reviews but this place stinks. My car was there for three weeks with nothing at all done. Kept getting the run around and told different things and it was still never repaired because I eventually got sick of waiting and getting rides everywhere and had my car towed to another shop. They bite off more than they can chew. The place is always full because they take on too much all at once. And to make matters worse the guy says they're not insured and won't be held responsible for anything that happens, break ins, someone hitting ur car, nothing at all!!! Very unprofessional!!

reviews.author: Ginny Radcliffe
reviews.text: Great prices very busy if you want floor boards kept clean put something down. Greasy garage but not as expensive as one that puts papers down on floor boards!!! Last time I went broke stuff I n car. And told them kept all repairs in glove box. I no longer have them and broke piece off glove box!! I had to take car back at least 10 times same problem. Was told by owner that car was suppose to reave up like crazy and take off skid out unless you wait till RPMS go down!!

reviews.author: Kemberley
reviews.text: Great service. Excellent work. He is absolutely The best. My new mechanic!!! Will definitely go again and I will absolutely recommend him to everyone I know best place ever. Great prices as well. Aso, Fast service too

reviews.author: Marshall Hartless
reviews.text: I took my vehicle to this shop to have the starter replaced. When I took it there, I was informed that the job should only take a couple hours to complete, so I should expect it back in a few days. A week and a half later it hadn't been touched. I called almost everyday or stopped in and asked the status, each time I was told they were working on my truck next. Finally I went in and after the older gentleman was very rude, decided to have it towed to another shop. The majority of the time a I called, the line was busy. In a nutshell, they don't keep the customer informed, they didn't get the work done in a timely manner and were never pleasant to deal with.

reviews.author: Keith Percy
reviews.text: Why in the world ppl rave about how great this place is is a mystery to me. They are sooooo slow. I think the ppl saying they are fast are lying, maybe ppl who work there and pretending to be customers. I took my car to Matt and didn't get it back for over a week, and this was after I called and hounded him repeatedly. I will never go there again. I also know other ppl who did business with Matt and regret it later, because they have jobs, families, kids ,and other obligations to tend to but can't because their vehicles sit in Matt's shop for days and weeks at a time. Ridiculous don't go here.

reviews.author: Faron Reactz
reviews.text: Brought my car here years ago off of a referral from a friend. Overnight, my car got broken into, windshield busted out as well as 2 other windows. CD player stolen, seats ripped off, lady across the street saw/heard it happen. Owner told me his garage wasn't insured and there was nothing he could do. Have a feeling he knew it had happened as well for weeks and didn't have the nuts to tell me because everytime I called to get the progress on my car, he'd tell me that he hadn't figured out what the timing should be yet. *The timing belt broke and timing was off. Owner said he had to order a book lol. Place sucks.

reviews.author: Ansley Gygi
reviews.text: I'm going to use these people as my mechanic from now on. They price everything very fairly, and i'm always concerned that mechanics are ripping me off. These guys wont. Totally trustworthy and honest.

reviews.author: Lei M
reviews.text: Went in this morning for a state inspection. I think Matt helped me. Cool guy and I was out in 30 minutes. Can’t beat that. Will definitely return in the future and refer friends

reviews.author: Macie Blankenship
reviews.text: This is my go-to mechanic for good work at fair prices. I'm usually in and out within 45 minutes for an oil change, which you can't beat.

reviews.author: Brandi Lynn “Tessa”
reviews.text: Great local place to have your car worked on or inspected! The guys are friendly and personable. Get there early
